whats_new.title: What's new

changelog.text:
*     **Gemini 3.5 Flash deprecation**:
  [`gemini-3.5-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.5) is deprecated and has been
  replaced by [`gemini-3.6-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6). It is no
  longer available to select in Google AI Studio, and API requests to
  `gemini-3.5-flash` are automatically routed to `gemini-3.6-flash`. Update
  your model string to `gemini-3.6-flash` (or
  [`gemini-3.8-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8)) and review the
  [Gemini 3.6 Flash guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6).

*     **Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite generally available (GA)**:
  Released stable, production-ready versions of our latest 3.x Flash models:

  *   **Gemini 3.6 Flash** (`gemini-3.6-flash`): Features improved token
    efficiency and code/agentic planning capabilities at a lower price point
    than 3.5 Flash, resolving developer feedback around output verbosity.
  *   **Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite** (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`): Offers a
    low-latency, highly cost-effective subagent option designed for
    high-volume automation.

  To learn more, see the [Gemini 3.6 Flash guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6).

*     **Deprecated parameters**: The sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p`
  and `top_k` are now deprecated. See the [Gemini 3.6 Flash
  guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6#sampling-parameter-deprecation) for
  details.
